title: Mixed references to turned-off features and green signals
summary: This topic cluster is loosely connected by words like turned, green, and nail, with only a few clear opinions amid many context-only fragments about features switching on or off, signals, and punctures.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention liking a previous sport model, approval of manual or automatic activation behavior, and a favorable framing of an automatic on-off feature.

negative.summary: Negative feedback complains that the driver and passenger climate controls do not automatically sync like in an older BMW.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly describe features being turned on or off, green lights or signals, emails, promises, and tire nails without enough context to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects joined mainly by recurring words rather than a single coherent customer issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too brief to support a stronger interpretation of customer sentiment.
Some positive examples are ambiguous in wording, so the concrete praised aspect is only partially clear from the fragment alone.
